authority: this file is the machine authority for a governed type's class, maturity, ontology class, payload model and legacy mapping (spec/sc-oes/03-event-types.md)

event_types.title: GNSS interference observed
event_types.description: An observation of interference with the reception of global navigation satellite system signals: what was observed, in which band, and how strongly. It reports a condition, not a cause: attributing the interference to an actor or geolocating its source is an assessment somebody makes and is a different semantic type.

event_types.title: Air track observed
event_types.description: An observation of an air track by a sensor or a reporting system. The broad legacy category is deliberately ungoverned: the same occurrence is honestly a detection to one producer and a track update to another, so ordinary CDM semantics decide `event_type`.

event_types.title: Runway availability changed
event_types.description: The represented availability of a runway has changed. The subject is the runway rather than the airfield, because a runway's availability moves independently of the facility that holds it.

event_types.title: Airspace restriction changed
event_types.description: A restriction on the use of an airspace has been imposed, altered or lifted. It is a CONSTRAINT rather than a STATE_CHANGE: what changed is what may be done, not what is.

event_types.title: Supply threshold reached
event_types.description: A held quantity of supply has reached a threshold the holder tracks. The threshold is the holder's own; this type carries that it was reached and does not assert that the level is good or bad, which is an assessment.

event_types.title: Route availability changed
event_types.description: The represented availability of a route used to move supply has changed.

event_types.title: Threat assessment updated
event_types.description: A revised judgement about a threat. An ASSESSMENT is an interpretation somebody is responsible for, and is never inferred from the observations behind it; those are carried as evidence and as DERIVED_FROM relationships.

event_types.title: System availability changed
event_types.description: The represented availability of a command-and-control or communication system has changed.

event_types.title: Mission status changed
event_types.description: The represented status of a mission has changed.

event_types.title: Operational impact assessed
event_types.description: An assessed operational consequence for a mission or an activity. IMPACT rather than ASSESSMENT because the subject is the consequence for an operation, which is what a consumer routes on.

event_types.title: Recommendation created
event_types.description: A course of action was proposed. A recommendation is not a decision and does not become one by being accepted downstream: the decision is its own event.

event_types.title: Decision recorded
event_types.description: A decision was taken, and by whom. The actor is the point of the record: a decision with no attributable decider is an assertion nobody owns.

event_types.title: Action authorized
event_types.description: An operational action was authorised. It records the authorisation, not the execution: whether the action then happened is a separate occurrence and a separate event.
